story.en: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha walks in: "We need top earning drivers per city for bonus distribution." Time to combine trips and drivers data.
story.ta: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha vandhu sonnaanga: "City-wise top earning drivers venum — bonus kudukanum." Trips-um drivers-um join panna time.
story.hi: Uber HQ, Friday shaam. Product manager Sneha bolti hai: "Har city ke top earning drivers chahiye — bonus dena hai." Trips aur drivers ko join karna padega.
story.te: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha cheppindi: "City-wise top earning drivers kavali — bonus ivvali." Trips mariyu drivers ni join cheyyali.

question.en: Find total earnings of each driver and show top 3 earning drivers per city.
question.ta: Oru driver evlo total earn pannirukkaan nu calculate panni, city-ku top 3 earning drivers kaatu.
question.hi: Har driver ka total earning nikalo aur har city ke top 3 drivers dikhao.
question.te: Prathi driver total earnings calculate chesi, prathi city lo top 3 drivers chupinchu.

title.hi: Drivers aur trips ko join karo
title.te: Drivers mariyu trips ni join cheyyali

steps.sql:
SELECT d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city, t.fare
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t
  ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id;

explain.en: JOIN combines rows from both tables using driver_id. Without join, trips and drivers stay disconnected.
explain.ta: JOIN rendu table data-vum connect pannum driver_id use panni. Join illa-na rendu table separate dhaan.
explain.hi: JOIN driver_id ke basis pe dono tables ko connect karta hai.
explain.te: JOIN driver_id base meeda rendu tables ni connect chestundi.

title.hi: Driver ke hisaab se total earnings nikalo

steps.sql:
SELECT d.driver_id,
       d.driver_name,
       d.city,
       SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t
  ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city;

explain.en: SUM(fare) adds all trip earnings per driver. GROUP BY ensures aggregation happens per driver.
explain.ta: SUM(fare) ella trips-oda earnings-a add pannum. GROUP BY driver-wise calculate pannum.
explain.hi: SUM(fare) har driver ki total earning nikalta hai.
explain.te: SUM(fare) prathi driver earnings ni kalipi total isthundi.

title.hi: Har city ke top 3 drivers nikalo
title.te: Prathi city lo top 3 drivers kanugonu

steps.sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT d.driver_id,
         d.driver_name,
         d.city,
         SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.city ORDER BY SUM(t.fare) DESC) AS rn
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN trips t
    ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3;

explain.en: ROW_NUMBER ranks drivers within each city based on earnings. PARTITION BY city resets ranking per city. We then filter top 3.
explain.ta: ROW_NUMBER city-wise rank assign pannum. PARTITION BY city-na each city-ku separate ranking. rn <= 3-na top 3.
explain.hi: ROW_NUMBER har city ke andar ranking deta hai.
explain.te: ROW_NUMBER prathi city lo ranking ivvadaniki use avutundi.
